title: Samsung takes Vietnam up semiconductor value chain with $5bn expansion
source_used: Vietnam Investment Review citing company press release
key_facts: Press release of 29 Sep: about $5.05B at Sejong and the Vietnam subsidiary.
$3.18B for FCBGA capacity at Sejong; about $1.85B for the Vietnam FCBGA plant.
Vietnam plant to complete construction and begin operations by June 2030.
FCBGA connects AI accelerators, GPUs and CPUs to the mainboard.
Investment pursued with customer funding support and volume guarantees from global big tech and chip customers.
quote_evidence: The investment is part of a total of approximately $5.05 billion at its Sejong business site and Vietnam subsidiary, according to a press release published on September 29.
The Vietnam subsidiary aims to complete construction and begin operations by June 2030.
FCBGA is a highly integrated semiconductor substrate that connects high-performance chips such as AI accelerators, GPUs, and CPUs to the mainboard.
